quotes.story: Ask HN: Do you use Claude Code, Codex, or something else?

quotes.quote: most recent Kilocode is streamlined into mediocrity
quotes.excerpt: Tldr; just teach them to talk to Codex and show Pi to ambitious ones. Raw Codex, both app and cli. On windows 11 which is horrible (sometimes in WSL, which sometimes crashes for no reason when I copy a lot of data around and somehow reverts contents of a mounted vhd virtual drive to previous state from long ago, after a crash). I'd love to switch to linux but I'm an avid gamer. I installed a linux on my old box thoug
quotes.story: Ask HN: What is your (AI) dev tech stack / workflow? (June 2026)
